icona-denaro: Available money: used to build and to pay for upkeep.
val-denaro: Money in the bank: grows with energy sales and taxes, shrinks with costs.
icona-carbone: Coal stock dug up by the mines.
val-carbone: Coal in stock: power plants burn it to make energy.
val-abitanti: Number of residents: they grow when they have energy and are happy.
icona-lavoro: Town workers: they fill the jobs of the connected buildings.
val-lavoro: Jobs filled out of the available workforce; jobs are assigned every hour by priority.
val-soddisfazione: Happiness: drops during blackouts, rises when energy never runs short.
icona-inquinamento: Pollution from the coal power plants.
val-inquinamento: Pollution: must stay below the limit by the deadline to win.
val-data: Game day and time: each turn is one hour, and demand peaks in the evening.
btn-salva: Save the game on this computer.
btn-play-pausa: Pause or resume the simulation (Space key).
avviso-pausa: Paused — press Space or ▶ to start
avviso-pausa-riprendi: Paused — press Space or ▶ to resume
meteo-nuvola: Current cloud cover: more clouds, less solar power.
meteo-vento: Current wind: it drives the wind farms.
meteo-stagione: Season of the year on the real calendar: spring from 21 Mar, summer from 21 Jun, autumn from 23 Sep, winter from 21 Dec.
prev-0: Weather forecast for the next hour.
prev-1: Weather forecast for the next 2 hours.
prev-2: Weather forecast for the next 3 hours.
obiet-abitanti: Goal: residents to reach before the game ends.
obiet-inquinamento: Goal: maximum pollution allowed by the deadline.
obiet-giorni: Days left to win the game.
obiet-debito: Debt: consecutive days with negative money; at 30 you lose.
btn-linea: Power line: connects tiles to the town hall's grid.
btn-miniera: Coal mine: digs coal into the shared stock, only on coal deposits.
btn-centrale_carbone: Coal power plant: steady energy from burning coal, but it pollutes.
btn-solare: Solar farm: produces during the day, depending on light and clouds.
btn-eolico: Wind farm: produces with the wind, up to 40% more on hills.
btn-batteria: Battery: stores the surplus and releases it at peak times (90% efficiency).
btn-quartiere: District: houses residents, who use energy mostly in the evening.
grafico: Production, demand and batteries over the last 24 hours: green bars production, red demand, blue stored charge.
ui.aiuti: [1-7] pick · click places · right-click demolishes · Esc cancels
obiet.debito.nessuno: Debt: no days in the red
info.casella.vuota: Click a tile on the map to see its details.
info.municipio:
Town hall — the heart of the power grid.
Power flows from here to the lines and the connected buildings.
It can't be demolished.
info.libera:
{terreno}.
Free: pick a building and click here to place it.
info.scollegata: Not connected to the town hall: it neither produces nor consumes.
costruzione.miniera.info.descrizione: Digs ~{carbone} coal per hour into the shared stock.
costruzione.centrale_carbone.info.descri: Up to {capacita} MWh/h, burns {consumo} coal/h. Production in the last hour: {produzione} MWh.
costruzione.solare.info.descrizione: Up to {capacita} MWh/h (more by day and in the sun). Production in the last hour: {produzione} MWh.
costruzione.eolico.info.descrizione: Up to {capacita} MWh/h (wind up to 20 m/s). Production in the last hour: {produzione} MWh.
costruzione.eolico.info.descrizione.coll: Up to {capacita} MWh/h (wind up to 20 m/s, +{bonus}% on a hill). Production in the last hour: {produzione} MWh.
costruzione.linea.descrizione: Connects tiles to the power grid: only what is connected to the town hall produces or consumes energy.
costruzione.miniera.descrizione: Digs coal into the shared stock; it can only be built on coal deposits.
costruzione.centrale_carbone.descrizione: Makes steady energy by burning coal from the shared stock, but it pollutes the town's air.
costruzione.solare.descrizione: Makes energy from the sun: output depends on daylight and cloud cover.
costruzione.eolico.descrizione: Makes energy from the wind, up to 40% more on hills; it stops when there is no wind.
costruzione.batteria.descrizione: Stores surplus energy and gives it back at peak times, with 90% efficiency.
costruzione.quartiere.descrizione: Houses the town's residents, who use energy mostly in the evening.
esito.sconfitta_debito: Money below zero for 30 game days in a row
esito.vittoria: A town of {abitanti} residents with pollution below the limit
esito.tempo_scaduto: Time's up: the town didn't reach the goal within 2 years
stato.senza_corrente: Grid: connected, without power this hour
stato.senza_personale: Grid: connected, no staff this hour
